corpus: 200 WA legislation documents seeded from the Open Australian Legal Corpus, plus the Fair Work Act 2009 (Cth) compilation 73 (4 volumes) ingested from the Federal Register.
note: Queries are paraphrases, not verbatim provision text, so the test is not trivially lexical. Targets are identified by citation and section, not by database id, so the set survives a reseed. The absent set must be re-checked whenever the corpus grows: two Fair Work queries were retired from it once the Act was ingested, because they stopped being absent.
